kitDescription: Rumani is a Fire rocket-launcher Defender with a Burst-I kit built around her Muscle Up mechanic: every fully-charged shot grants her a small stacking Max HP buff (up to 5 stacks, 2 seconds each), and fully-charged shots landed during Full Burst taunt the enemy for 5 seconds. Her Skill 2 rewards hitting enemy parts — after 5 parts hits the whole team gains a parts-damage buff for 5 seconds. Her burst raises her own Max HP for 10 seconds and, more importantly, gives the entire team a 10% normal-attack damage multiplier for 10 seconds — the kit's only real offensive contribution. If Muscle Up is at max stacks when she bursts, she also takes 20% less damage for 10 seconds. On the scope-lock partless boss, everything except the burst's team normal-attack buff is either defensive or parts-related and moves no damage.

verdictRationale: No real gotchas: every divergence the blind agents surfaced is either a blind-side artifact or a documented, damage-zero modeling choice. The S5 run vs the shipped override is 9 GREEN / 2 RED; RED-1 is a RECON_ERROR (the blind maxStacks filter sweeps in the burst's single maxHpFlat grant, so the every(===5) assertion fails on its own filter — the driver's spec pins the true stack sequence [1,2,3,4,5], 1 apply per shot, 2s expiry, and the post-reload sawtooth reset, all green), and RED-2 is the parts-line disposition split (blind: unreachable trigger → unmodeled; driver: hitCount 5 → inert partsDamagePct with a documented ⚑) on which the S2b spec explicitly ruled either encoding acceptable and whose damage outcome is byte-identical zero. The two load-bearing-ish lines converged byte-identically across the independent derivations: the burst's all-ally normalAttackPct 10.05 (correct bucket vs the attackDamagePct misread, correct burstCast trigger proven in the B1-contention arm against liter, correct all-allies scope) and the self Max-HP grants (magnitude cross-pinned by the exact 15.13/3.04 ratio). Both catastrophic over-credit traps named by S2b — parts buff as generic attackDamagePct, and the self Damage Taken ▼ flipped into the boss damageTakenPct channel — are directly asserted against and absent. Discrimination holds on every load-bearing test (passive-misread, fullBurstEnter-misread, bucket-misread, scope-misread, unconditional-gate arms all go red where they should). Same-model residual for the owner to spot-check: convergence here is three instances of one model agreeing, so the shared conventions deserve the eyeball — (a) the muscleUp resource pool never lapsing vs the real 2s stack expiry (the ⚑ with a footage recipe; currently damage-inert but it will silently govern any future HP-scaler or mitigation consumer), and (b) the parts-trigger proxy counting every hit as a parts hit, which stays honest only as long as partsDamagePct remains inert.
